messages.content: I am looking for a hair dresser in the San Lorenzo vicinity.

function.name: Alarm_1_GetAlarms
function.description: Retrieve a list of alarms that the user has set in the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user whose alarms are to be fetched.

include_disabled.description: Whether to include disabled alarms in the result.

alarm_type.description: The type of alarms to retrieve.

function.name: Alarm_1_AddAlarm
function.description: Set a new alarm with a specified time and optional custom name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

new_alarm_time.description: The time to set for the new alarm in 24-hour format (HH:MM).

new_alarm_name.description: The custom name to assign to the new alarm.

function.name: Messaging_1_ShareLocation
function.description: This function allows a user to share their current geographic location with a specified contact in their address book. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic coordinates or address to share, in the format of 'Latitude, Longitude' (e.g., '37.7749, -122.4194') or a physical address (e.g., '1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA').

contact_name.description: The full name of the contact to whom the location will be sent.

function.name: Services_1_BookAppointment
function.description: This function books an appointment with a specified hair stylist or salon on a desired date and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

stylist_name.description: The full name of the hair stylist or the name of the salon.

appointment_date.description: The date for the appointment in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-10-05'.

appointment_time.description: The time for the appointment in 24-hour format 'HH:MM', such as '14:30'.

function.name: Services_1_FindProvider
function.description: Search for a hair stylist in a specified city, with options to filter for unisex salons. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city where the stylist or salon is sought, such as 'New York, NY'. State names must be abbreviated with two letters.

is_unisex.description: Indicates whether the salon caters to all genders. True for yes, False for no.
